ceiling_directive: Establish finite tail selection and a uniform Cesaro-attraction modulus for the published Guo--Xu no-intercept recursion itself, thereby transferring the mixed-normal and studentization results from the note's constructed conditional class to a published adaptive-design class.
improvement_directive: Prove that switching-layer occupation in the exact Guo--Xu recursion is asymptotically negligible and derive explicit compact-initial-set sequences r_T(K_0), delta_T(K_0) tending to zero; then verify finite-attractor-class membership and instantiate Theorems 1--2.
critique: The note proves an explicit counterexample to Saco's v1 theorem and restores normality only after imposing an early-measurable suffix-QV condition that directly assumes relative predictable-QV stabilization. It does not characterize validity on Saco's published variance-growth class, so the framing of an "inference frontier" or exact temporal boundary overstates a sufficient condition plus one violating witness. The finite-attractor mixed-normal and pivotality results assume finite tail selection and a vanishing uniform Cesaro-attraction modulus; these load-bearing dynamics are not established for the Guo--Xu recursion, and the HeartSteps discussion is only a consumer interpretation. The deterministic-sandwich iff statements are conditional scale-mixture identification and polarization results, leaving the unverified recursion-to-class bridge as the specific obstacle to field tier.
